about: PixelClock Desktop tokens. The single source of the palette and the type scale: tools/lib/tokens.mjs generates tokens.css (CSS variables) and pcd-tokens.js (PCD.TOKENS) from this file and fails the build when a contrast pair below misses its minimum. Colours with source clock are the clock's simulator/style.css :root (ring is its alarm-glow border); frame and faint are this project's additions.

bg.role: page, the colour the dimmed scene mixes toward, the veil

muted.role: secondary text, unselected labels, tags, phase

faint.role: credits, hints, strip times, the terminal ghost, ( ) [ ] brackets; lifted from #8b8178 so faint text over the dimmed scene keeps 4.5:1

accent.role: only what is alive: colon, prompt, caret, now bar, link digits, the settings row cursor, ringing alarm

frame.role: box lines, the glyphs ⌂ ≡ · and the › of the terminal's echoed commands

ring.role: the clock status line's ringing pulse, the weather sun and bolt, the terminal's ! marks

wood.role: the big clock's ░ shadow, the terminal rule, the strip's day bars, text selection

wood-dark.role: not used on screen (kept for the style tile)

contrast.about: WCAG 2.2 pairs the build gates (min), with the ratio each pair was designed to (design, 1 decimal). never: pairs that must not appear on screen.

pairs.why: passes since faint was lifted from #8b8178 (4.05:1 here); placeholders inside a well still use muted

decorative.why: the clock's shadow, the terminal rule, the strip's day bars

derived.about: Colours computed once a minute at run time (PCD.color in src/shared/pcd-core.js) and never transitioned.

clock.rule: mix(theme clock colour, text, 0.25), or text when that is under 4.5:1 on bg

bar.rule: mix(line, wood, min(1, gain x v)) for the light level v (0..1); the bar holding now is accent

type.about: One size per screen: the ladder step nearest cssH x dpr / div (ties go to the smaller step), never under the floor; the CSS size is step / dpr. Cells floor to whole device pixels.
